rule: The runtimes, transports, sandbox profiles (environments), credential scopes (pools), tools, features and known limitations a Pantheon seat is served through, as the CODE provides them. Every claim cites the code: evidence {file, quote}, the quote read verbatim in that file at the checkout observed (pantheon/src/capability/graph.mjs). A claim whose quote is not found is recorded unresolved, never established. An isolation property holds only where it is declared and its evidence is found: nothing is recorded as isolated that the code does not isolate. A model is not its runtime: models are pantheon.models facts; this file never names one.
